capabilities: Scan a vault folder for TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2 font files
Assign separate fonts to UI, body text, code blocks and LaTeX math
Group Regular, Italic, Bold and Bold Italic variants into font families
Split Latin and CJK characters with unicode-range control
Apply font presets per device or per device type
extras: Works fully offline with no telemetry; reads hostname, a hashed mobile device identifier and app language for the device list and translations. Warns that dense multilingual text on one line can freeze rendering, and that mobile device identity can change after a factory reset or reinstall.
motivation: To keep fonts local and private instead of relying on external CDNs or system fonts.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to use font files stored in the vault, so custom fonts depend on system installs or external CDNs.
summary: Loads TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2 font files from a vault folder and applies them to the UI, body text, code blocks and math.
